title: Account Executive, Private Equity Real Estate
description:
About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

Juniper Square is hiring an Account Executive to join our Real Assets Sales team, partnering with investment managers across commercial real estate and broader real assets. As a Real Assets Account Executive, you’ll lead the full sales cycle and play a key role in driving revenue growth. Our customers and prospects will look to you as a trusted advisor who can thoughtfully map Juniper Square’s solutions to their business needs.

In this role, you will identify and develop new opportunities, build strong and lasting relationships, guide prospects through a thorough evaluation process, and collaborate cross-functionally to ensure deal success. You’ll forecast with precision, manage a healthy pipeline, and consistently meet or exceed revenue targets.

You’ll be joining a team-oriented, high-performing group of sellers who are deeply invested in understanding our prospects, our clients, and the PERE ecosystem. We operate with a blend of SaaS and professional-services sales motions, and our team’s diverse experience is a key driver of our continued success.

What you’ll do

  • Engage directly with prospective Private Equity Real Estate and Real Assets firms to sell fund administration and software solutions.

  • Acquire new clients and develop ongoing account strategies to drive expansion and revenue growth within existing relationships.

  • Partner closely with Sales Development, Fund Solutions, and Solutions Engineering teams to originate, manage, and close new business.

  • Deliver a best-in-class buying experience by understanding customer needs and guiding them through an effective evaluation process.

  • Build consensus and executive alignment across stakeholders to drive mutually beneficial outcomes.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with key external partners—CPA firms, banks, law firms, and other industry stakeholders.

  • Contribute to refining and optimizing our go-to-market approach as we deepen our understanding of product-market fit.

  • Represent Juniper Square at in-person and virtual industry events

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of B2B, full-cycle, quota-carrying sales experience.

  • Experience selling fund administration services, FinTech solutions, SaaS products, or comparable offerings.

  • Knowledge of or experience within the CRE ecosystem is a strong preference

  • Strong curiosity and eagerness to deeply understand our market and customer needs.

  • Demonstrated integrity, ethics, and alignment with company values.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to a range of audiences.

  • Ability to prioritize outcomes that drive both commercial success and customer value.

  • Proficiency with sales tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, and Gong.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to lead and coordinate across multiple stakeholders.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, commission, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary target for this role is $145,000. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

  • Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability coverage

  • Mental wellness coverage

  • Fertility and growing family support

  • Unlimited vacation in addition to company-paid holidays

  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

  • 401k retirement savings plan

  • Healthcare FSA and commuter benefits programs

  • Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

  • Annual professional development stipend

title: Implementation Consultant - Functional
description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

We are seeking an Implementation Consultant (Functional/Project Lead) to lead the functional and project management work required to successfully deploy our SaaS platform for enterprise utility customers. This role is critical to ensuring structured, well-coordinated, and repeatable implementations for customers operating critical infrastructure.


The Implementation Consultant serves as the functional owner of implementation workstreams, partnering closely with a dedicated Tech/Solution Consultant, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to deliver high-quality customer deployments. This role focuses on business process alignment, project coordination, and customer-facing enablement required to bring customers live — including requirements gathering, timeline management, stakeholder coordination, and functional configuration decisions (hazard/task libraries, templates, workflows, roles and permissions).


This is a high-impact opportunity within a growing enterprise SaaS organization supporting the Utilities & Energy sector, where operational alignment, clear communication, and reliable project delivery are essential.


Location: United States (Remote) with up to 50% travel


Duties and Responsibilities:

Implementation & Project Leadership

  • Lead the functional implementation workstream for enterprise customer deployments from kickoff through go-live, demonstrating accountability for delivery quality and outcomes
  • Own the project timeline, task tracking, and coordination across internal teams and customer stakeholders
  • Conduct discovery sessions to understand customer business processes, operational workflows, and organizational requirements
  • Translate business requirements into functional configuration plans — hazard/task libraries, templates, workflows, roles and permissions
  • Partner closely with the Tech/Solution Consultant to align functional decisions with technical implementation (integrations, SSO, data migration, environment setup)
  • Lead regular customer checkpoints, status updates, and cross-functional alignment meetings
  • Track and document implementation activities to support transparency, knowledge sharing, and repeatability

Business Process & Configuration Design

  • Lead business process design workshops with customer stakeholders (Safety Managers, Ops Leads, Supervisors)
  • Own configuration decisions related to forms, templates, hazard/control libraries, and workflow design
  • Validate that configured workflows reflect real-world field operations and customer requirements
  • Partner with SMEs to ensure the solution supports day-to-day operational needs

Training, Adoption & Change Support

  • Support training planning and delivery, partnering with the Comms/Change Lead on rollout strategy
  • Identify Field Champions and support their enablement ahead of Field Pilot
  • Gather and incorporate field feedback during Pilot and early go-live into configuration adjustments
  • Communicate new product releases and relevant feature updates to customers, helping them understand and adopt new capabilities as they become available

Testing, Validation & Go-Live Readiness

  • Coordinate UAT planning and execution from a functional/business-process perspective
  • Identify and communicate functional risks, dependencies, or blockers impacting launch readiness
  • Support go-live cutover planning and ensure clean handoff to Customer Success and Support

Scalable Implementation Practices

  • Identify recurring functional/configuration challenges and convert them into reusable templates and standard approaches
  • Collaborate with Product to shape configuration tooling and platform enhancements based on field learnings
  • Create documentation or toolsets that reduces manual effort and improves implementation velocity across future deployments

Required Skills & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in implementation consulting, project management, business analysis, or customer-facing SaaS deployment roles
  • Proven experience leading project or functional workstreams for enterprise software implementations
  • Ability to translate customer business requirements into scalable, well-documented configuration plans
  • Strong project management skills — timeline management, stakeholder coordination, risk/dependency tracking
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with a technical counterpart (Tech/Solution Consultant), customer stakeholders, and internal cross-functional teams
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead workshops and build stakeholder confidence and trust

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience implementing software for utility, energy, industrial, or regulated enterprise customers
  • Experience deploying software to field/frontline environments (mobile applications, operational or field-based platforms) is a plus
  • Familiarity with change management or training rollout for operational teams
  • Background in business process design, workflow configuration, or configuration-heavy SaaS platforms
  • Experience with reporting or dashboards using SQL and visualization tools

Physical Demands: No specific physical demands associated with this position.

Benefits Info:

This position also includes a competitive benefit package including; financial, social, health and wellbeing programs, paid vacation, 401k matching, employee stock purchase program, hybrid work schedule, and more!

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!

We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by

1) providing the best services for homebuyers

2) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance

3) to protect the whole home

As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: Service Representative II
Location: India
Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we’d love for you to be a part of it as us as Service Representative II, you are expected to execute the following in an effective manner and conducive with our contractor code of conduct and within your contracted hours, full US time-zone overlap.

  • Assist customers and MSPs (Moving Service Providers) with order modifications.
  • Handle follow up with customers and MSPs in a timely manner.
  • Handle follow up confirmation text, calls and emails.
  • Handle fee disputes.
  • Payment release requests.
  • Handle refunds.
  • Handle tentative orders.
  • Request and process COI requests as needed.
  • Assist with quality assurance spot-checks on order handling, fee disputes, and refunds.
  • Identify and flag recurring issues or process improvement opportunities to Service Operations leadership.

  • Payment release request.
  • Requests for help during the job.
  • Cancellation request.

  • Prior customer service experience, 2 years minimum.
  • Positive, empathetic, and professional attitude toward customers (consumers, moving service providers) and peers at all times.
  • Ability to learn and retain product details to ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in U.S. customer service.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a Senior Agent, Team Lead, or Supervisory capacity within U.S. customer service, BPO, or home services/moving-industry environment OR 8 years of experience in U.S. customer service.
  • Higher Secondary Certificate (10+2) or equivalent.
  • Preferred: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Communications, Supply Chain/Logistics,Hospitality Management, or similar.
  • Excellent written and verbal English language skills.
  • Ability to work scheduled hours during business hours and as required by business needs.

title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization.

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

  • Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice.

  • Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism.

  • Be the go-to expert in one or more domains, such as MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, EKS, VMware, data, security or networking.

  • Help shape our technical offerings and accelerators in line with market and AWS trends.



What you bring:

  • 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and delivering on AWS.

  • A proven track record of leading at least two large-scale cloud migrations end to end.

  • Hands-on database migration experience with MSSQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect â Professional.

  • In-depth knowledge of core AWS services, including:

    • Compute and containers: EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS

    • Storage and databases: S3, RDS, EFS, EBS

    • Networking and integration: VPC, API Gateway, CloudFront, SNS, SQS

    • Security: IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, KMS, AWS Private CA

  • Hands-on experience building and running CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, GitLab, Bitbucket or similar.

  • Experience running containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes or EKS.

  • Strong networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls and VPN, plus AWS networking services such as VPC, Route 53, ELB and CloudFront.

  • Strong security knowledge: IAM, least privilege, access control, endpoint security and data encryption.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. You are confident with executives and engineering teams alike.

  • Comfort working in a distributed team, with a few hours of daily overlap with Central European Time.

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.


Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with AWS MAP phases: Assess, Mobilize, and Migrate & Modernize.

description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

Position Type: Per Diem
Work Arrangement: Field-Based â Patient Home Visits

Caringhand Home Health Solutions, Inc. is committed to providing professional nursing and healthcare services that help patients achieve the highest possible level of independence in their daily activities. We strive to deliver high-quality home health care through comprehensive patient assessments, individualized care planning, and collaboration among healthcare professionals, patients, and families.

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to provide skilled nursing care to patients in their homes and communities. The RN will assess patient and family needs, develop and implement individualized care plans, administer prescribed medications and treatments, educate patients and caregivers, and coordinate care with physicians and other healthcare professionals.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong clinical judgment, excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. This role also involves discharge planning, case management when assigned, and supervising and evaluating home health aide services to support safe, coordinated, and effective patient care.

If you are passionate about helping patients maintain their independence and well-being at home, we encourage you to join our team.

Note: This is a field-based, per diem position that requires travel to patientsâ homes. Although listed as âremote,â this is not a work-from-home or telehealth role.

Responsibilities
    • Conduct initial patient and family assessments to determine home health care needs, including physical assessments and histories of current and previous illnesses.
    • Regularly reassess patientsâ nursing needs and evaluate changes in their conditions.
    • Initiate and revise individualized plans of care as patient status and needs change.
    • Use assessment findings to establish nursing diagnoses and develop appropriate care plans.
    • Develop care plans that establish patient-centered goals and incorporate therapeutic, preventive, and rehabilitative nursing interventions.
    • Involve patients and their families in care planning and decision-making.
    • Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by the physician.
    • Implement appropriate preventive and rehabilitative nursing procedures.
    • Counsel patients and families regarding nursing and related healthcare needs.
    • Provide patient and caregiver education based on assessments and the established plan of care.
    • Identify discharge planning needs during care planning and implement appropriate arrangements before patient discharge.
    • Serve as case manager when assigned by the Clinical Supervisor or Nursing Supervisor, coordinating care for the assigned patient caseload.
    • Prepare accurate clinical notes and update the primary physician as needed and at least every 60 days.
    • Communicate patient needs and changes in condition to physicians, and obtain or receive physician orders as required.
    • Coordinate with community healthcare professionals and other relevant parties to support the patient's plan of care.
    • Participate in on-call duties according to organizational policy.
    • Ensure arrangements for necessary equipment, supplies, and other patient services.
    • Instruct, supervise, and evaluate home health aide services provided to patients every two weeks.
    • Perform other related duties as assigned to support patient care.
    • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing.
    • Current, active Registered Nurse (RN) license in California.
    • At least 1â2 years of recent acute care experience in an institutional setting.
    • Current CPR certification.
    • Valid driver's license and access to a reliable vehicle insured in accordance with state and organizational requirements.
    • Excellent observation and clinical assessment skills.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
    • Effective problem-solving skills and basic mathematical skills.
    • Ability to perform nursing duties according to established competency requirements.
    • Ability to work independently and coordinate patient care responsibilities.
    • Ability to perform the physical duties associated with patient care, including prolonged standing or walking, lifting supplies and equipment, and assisting with patient positioning or transfers, with applicable accommodations.

Preferred Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in nursing.
    • At least 1 year of home health care experience.

Additional role responsibility: The RN is responsible for supervising home health aides. Previous management experience is not required.

title: PR Teamlead (m/w/d)
description:
Overview

PR steht vor einem strukturellen Bruch. Vertrauen verschiebt sich, Sichtbarkeit wird neu verteilt, KI wächst exponentiell. Wir bei getpress glauben, dass Reputation in den nächsten zehn Jahren der entscheidende Wettbewerbsvorsprung für Unternehmen wird.

Deshalb bauen wir die PR Company der Zukunft. Outcome-getrieben statt Retainer-Stunden. KI-first statt KI-on-top. Automatisiert, wo es skaliert und menschlich, wo es wirklich zählt. Unser über 40-köpfiges Team aus Journalist*innen und PR-Strateg*innen hat seit 2017 die PR für 450+ der spannendsten Wachstumsunternehmen Europas gesteuert – und will mehr.

Als PR Teamlead bist du nicht nur senior in deiner eigenen PR-Expertise, sondern gibst dein Wissen weiter, entwickelst erfahrene PR-Köpfe und Nachwuchstalente und trägst Verantwortung für ein wachsendes Kundenportfolio.

Bist du dabei?

Deine Rolle

Als Teamlead arbeitest du nicht mehr selbst operativ auf Kund*innen, sondern ausschließlich über dein Team – dein Impact entsteht durch gute Führung, nicht durch eigene Pitches.

  • Teamentwicklung: Du bist Vorbild und Fels in der Brandung. Mit weekly 1:1s, regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und individuellen Entwicklungsplänen erkennst du Stärken und Entwicklungspotenziale. Du entwickelst deine Teammitglieder individuell, vom Junior bis zum Senior.
  • Kundenportfolio: Du hast den Überblick über den Status aller Kund*innen im Team, bist strategische Ansprechperson auf Entscheiderebene und erkennst frühzeitig Risiken, ebenso wie Upsell-Potenziale und Wachstumschancen. So sorgst du langfristig für ein gesundes Portfolio in deinem Team.
  • Unternehmerisches Handeln: Dein Team ist eine kleine unternehmerische Einheit innerhalb von getpress: Du triffst strategische Entscheidungen auf Basis von KPIs und steuerst Team- und Kundenplanung. Dabei bist du nicht scheu, Entscheidungen zu treffen, zu priorisieren und zu delegieren.
  • Sales & Recruiting: Du arbeitest punktuell eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen, etwa bei Neukund*innenpitches. Genauso eng arbeitest du mit People & Culture zusammen, wenn es um Mitarbeiterentwicklung, Onboarding und Recruiting geht.
  • Struktur & Qualität: Du baust Prozesse, die dein Team wirklich braucht, basierend auf den Bedürfnissen, die du erkennst. Du sorgst für gemeinsame Routinen, begleitest das Onboarding und trägst die Verantwortung für die Qualitätssicherung im Team.

Wer du bist

  • Du bringst über 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der operativen PR mit (idealerweise im Agenturumfeld) und hast selbst Kund*innen aus dem Mittelstand und vergleichbaren Unternehmensgrößen direkt betreut, weiterentwickelt und nachweislich in deutschen Leit- und Fachmedien platziert. Diese Erfahrung ist deine Basis.
  • Du hast bereits ein Team geführt und weiterentwickelt, disziplinarisch wie fachlich. Idealerweise hast du schon Change-Prozesse begleitet und weißt, wie man ein Team sicher durch Phasen des Wandels führt.
  • Du bringst erprobte Führungsskills, eine hohe emotionale Intelligenz und ein ehrliches Interesse für Menschen und ihre Entwicklung mit.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und hast ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Geschäftsstrategien. KPIs nutzt du bewusst und regelmäßig, um daraus strategische Entscheidungen abzuleiten.
  • Du bist Kommunikator*in durch und durch – im Team hörst du zu und nimmst Menschen mit; extern kommunizierst du souverän mit Kund*innen und Stakeholdern über Hierarchieebenen hinweg, vom CEO bis zum Marketing-Ansprechpartner.
  • Der Einsatz von KI in der PR-Arbeit ist für dich gelebter Alltag, keine Theorie. Du bist neugierig, testest aus, was möglich ist und teilst dein Wissen im Team.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, kannst auch auf Englisch professionell kommunizieren und lebst in Deutschland.

Was dich erwartet

  • Echte PR-Arbeit. Bei uns geht es um echte Pressearbeit, individuell und zielgerichtet. Keine Standard-Pressemitteilungen, sondern individuelles Pitchen bei Journalist*innen in einer breiten Range an Medien.
  • Optimismus. Wir glauben, dass man aus Fehlern lernt und dass eine optimistische Grundhaltung den Unterschied macht. Das merkt man nicht nur in unserem Daily Doing, sondern auch bei spontanen Coffee-Talks oder unseren regelmäßigen Teamevents, ob digital oder vor Ort.
  • Impact. Wir haben hohe Standards an unsere eigene Arbeit, aber auch an die Unternehmen, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten. Vor allem in Europa gibt es mehr Hidden Champions als sichtbare Erfolgsgeschichten. Das ist die Lücke, die wir schließen wollen.
  • Sparring. Du stehst nie alleine da: Regelmäßiges Sparring gehört bei uns zum Alltag. Mit deiner eigenen Führungskraft, unserer Head of PR, ebenso wie mit anderen Teamleads, dem C-Level oder People & Culture, je nachdem, welches Thema gerade ansteht.
  • Perspektive. Auch als Teamlead lernt man nicht aus. Wir planen langfristig und wollen deine persönliche Entwicklung fördern. Du startest mit einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag, und mit unserem Wachstum wächst auch der Raum, dein Wissen einzubringen und mit uns zu lernen. Etwa indem du uns bei Projekten oder der Entwicklung neuer Services unterstützt.
  • Flexibilität. Wir arbeiten hybrid, remote (in DE) oder im Office. Wir haben zwar Kernerreichbarkeitszeiten, aber wann du arbeitest, entscheidest du abgestimmt auf die Bedürfnisse von Team und Kund*innen. Vertrauen, Eigenständigkeit und Kommunikation sind für uns das A und O und sorgen dafür, dass wir Job und Privatleben gut miteinander vereinen können.
  • Benefits und Sweet Treats. Du kannst aus drei frei wählbaren Sachbezügen wählen, von einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit 20% Zuschuss auf deine Einzahlungen profitieren, 180 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten, dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents freuen. Und das Beste: Du startest mit 27 Urlaubstagen, aber je länger du bei uns bist, desto mehr Urlaubstage bekommst du dazu.

Wie gehts weiter?

Wenn du jetzt denkst: ,,Klingt nach mir!'', dann bewirb dich ohne Anschreiben bei uns und wer weiß, vielleicht bist du schon schneller als gedacht Teil unseres getpress-Teams!

title: Customer Support Specialist (m/w/x)
description:
Unser Herz schlägt im Hamburger Office, denn hier entstehen unsere Ideen und unser Teamspirit. Konkret bedeutet das: in den ersten 6 Wochen wünschen wir uns, dass du an 4 Tagen / Woche aus unserem Büro in Hamburg arbeitest. Langfristig freuen wir uns über eine regelmäßige Anwesenheit an etwa 2-3 Tagen / Woche (mehr geht natürlich immer). Hauptsache, wir bleiben im Alltag connected.

Deine Mission

Unsere Kunden lieben es, wenn ihre Geräte einfach funktionieren. Und wenn nicht – dann bist du da. Mit Empathie, Köpfchen und klarer Kommunikation.

Als Customer Support Specialist bei WhereverSIM bist du mehr als nur Support.

Du bist technische:r Ansprechpartner:in für unsere B2B Kunden, Expert:in für komplexe Fälle und gleichzeitig Mitgestalter:in für bessere Prozesse, verständliche Kommunikation und langfristige Kundenzufriedenheit.

Aufgaben

💬 1st Level Support: Du bist die Anlaufstelle für technische Anfragen über E-Mail, Telefon oder unser Ticketsystem und unterstützt beim technischen Onboarding unserer Kunden.

🛠 2nd Level Support: Hier wird’s knifflig. Du löst komplexere Fälle, arbeitest mit dem DevOps- und Produkt-Team zusammen und bist verantwortlich für die technische Realisierung der Projekte unserer Kunden.

📊 Servicequalität sicherstellen: Du achtest auf unsere SLA-Zeiten, hältst unsere Kunden proaktiv auf dem Laufenden und begeisterst diese mit deiner Zuverlässigkeit und Gewissenhaftigkeit.

📚 Wissenstransfer und Kompetenzaufbau: Du pflegst FAQs, entwickelst Tutorials für unsere Kunden und dokumentierst deine Lösungen für andere Teams (z.B. Sales).

📈 Prozessverbesserung: Du erkennst Muster, denkst mit, entwickelst Templates für häufige Anliegen und hilfst dabei, dass der Support jeden Tag ein Stück besser wird.

Typische Tickets?

1st Level Support

Who we are

CEPA Study Abroad is a U.S. based study abroad organization that partners with schools to develop and run custom faculty-led programs in over 40 countries. CEPA was founded in 1997 and operates study abroad programs across Europe, including European Study Centers in France and Germany. Our main administrative offices are in Besigheim, Germany and Strasbourg, France. CEPA also partners with the CEPA Foundation to provide service-learning opportunities in Costa Rica, Peru, and Guatemala, programs that align with our organization’s commitment to environmental and humanitarian engagement.

We are a small marketing team, very much mission and values driven, focused on building collaborative relationships and providing meaningful and challenging study abroad programs that enable students to broaden their global perspective, deepen their knowledge, and develop personally and professionally. We are committed to social responsibility and environmental sustainability and have been offsetting our carbon footprint since 2019.

CEPA Study Abroad joined Terra Education in 2026, giving the organization the opportunity to expand its study abroad programs to additional destinations outside of Europe, working alongside our colleagues at Terra who have long-standing expertise in Africa, Asia and Central & South America.

Your Role and Responsibilities

For our team in Besigheim, we are looking for a motivated working student with an interest in IT, digitalization, and artificial intelligence, who is keen to gain practical experience in a modern, international work environment.

In this role, you will not only contribute to ongoing IT projects but also actively support the implementation of new digital solutions and AI applications that are set to transform the way we work within the company.

Your tasks

Depending on your interests and current needs, you will support us with tasks including:

  • Maintaining and further developing our Microsoft 365 environment

  • Setting up and configuring hardware and software

  • Providing first-level support to employees with technical questions

  • Supporting IT projects and rollouts

  • Analyzing, documenting, and automating workflows

  • Implementing and using AI solutions such as MS Copilot

  • Digitalizing and optimizing internal processes

  • Researching and evaluating new technologies and AI applications

  • Creating instructions, training materials, and documentation

Working hours: up to 20 hours/week during the semester, more hours possible during semester breaks by arrangement. Duration of the contract: initially 6 months with the possibility to extend.

What you bring to the table

  • Currently enrolled in a degree program (ideally in your first semester) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Business Informatics, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a comparable field of study in the Heilbronn, Ludwigsburg, or Stuttgart region

  • Enthusiasm for digitalization, modern IT solutions, and AI technologies

  • Practical and solution-oriented approach to work

  • Interested in taking on responsibility to take on responsibilities and drive projects forward independently

  • Excellent written and spoken German and English skills

  • Friendly demeanor and enjoyment of working with international teams

  • Current enrollment at a university

What you can expect:

  • Exciting practical experience in the future-oriented fields of IT, digitalization, and AI

  • Participation in real projects with tangible benefits

  • Direct insight into strategic digitalization initiatives

  • High degree of autonomy and short decision-making processes

  • Flexible working hours that can be combined with your studies

  • International work environment with colleagues in Europe and the USA

  • Modern IT infrastructure and the opportunity to actively shape new technologies

  • Personal and professional development

The Stuttgart/ Heilbronn region is currently developing into one of Germany’s most exciting hubs for AI and innovation. At the same time, we offer the opportunity to play a direct role in the digital advancement of an internationally active company.

Do you want to go beyond just studying AI—do you want to apply it in a real-world context? If so, we look forward to receiving your application.

Candidates should have a background in data science or a related field, with an interest in practical AI applications in a professional setting.

title: Satellite Systems Engineer
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital builds a space infrastructure providing a fast & simple path to orbit. Using different flight proven buses, we design, integrate and operate spacecrafts, to fly physical or virtual customers payloads. We handle entire missions from end to end, significantly reducing the lead-time and risk of a traditional space mission.

As a Satellite Systems Engineer at Loft, you will work on one or several satellite missions simultaneously, each one flying a single/multi-payload configuration. You will be a technical reference for these missions, working closely with program manager and all the Loft teams: products development teams, flight and ground software, AIT and operations.

Using flight proven satellite buses and Loft designed payload hub infrastructure, you will lead the development activities of the missions you are in charge of.


About this Role:
  • Serve as satellite systems engineer for one or more customer missions, representing Loft in technical discussions and reviews to accommodate and fly a variety of payloads
  • Act as the internal payload subject-matter expert, interfacing with hardware and software teams to ensure end-to-end integration.
  • Work with flight operations to develop the mission CONOPS, supporting the development of Service Level Agreements with Loft's customers
  • Assist with program management and product management, including interfacing with customers on programmatic and schedule matters
  • Review test plans and test results, and participate in the integration, test campaign, launch and in-orbit activities 
  • Accommodate customer missions on Loft’s rideshare programs, contributing to satellite-level budgets and analyses, V&V planning, CONOPS definition, AIT, and on-orbit operations.

    • Must Haves:
  • A minimum of 5 years of demonstrated experience as a spacecraft systems engineer, or equivalent experience in at least two different subsystems (ADCS, Mechanical, Thermal, Power, On-Board Electronics & Software, …)
  • You have strong communication and organizational skills
  • You challenge norms in aerospace engineering and testing activities and or experienced in fast-paced development environment
  • You have experience in small satellite assembly, integration and test campaigns, and/or in spacecraft delivery to orbit
  • You handle pressure positively and are always ready to put hands-on

    • Nice to Haves:
  • Experience with Python and Jupyter notebooks for analysis and simulation
  • Exposure to different space payload technologies (e.g., RF, optical, radar, hosted compute,…)
  • Exposure to in-orbit operations 
  • International experience

    • Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    •  *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

title: Seller Onboarding and Support Intern
description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Join Back Market's dynamic Seller Success team as the driving force behind our seller ecosystem! As Europe's leading refurbished electronics marketplace, we're revolutionizing how businesses connect with millions of customers across the EU, the UK and the US.

As a Seller Activation Intern (Onboarding & Seller Support), you'll be at the heart of our growth strategy, transforming thousands of potential sellers into thriving Back Market partners. You'll master the art of business prioritization, relationship building, and data-driven decision making while gaining hands-on experience in one of Europe's fastest-growing tech companies.

This isn't just about processing applications – you'll be identifying high-potential business opportunities, strategically prioritizing sellers based on market potential, and directly impacting our marketplace expansion across Europe and the United States. At the same time, you'll play a hands-on role in improving how we work — collaborating with cross-functional teams to spot inefficiencies in our seller activation processes and helping design better, more scalable solutions.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Strategic Seller Management: Navigate through our extensive database of thousands of potential sellers, qualifying and prioritizing them based on business potential and strategic fit

  • Business Development: Provide professional consultation and support via Salesforce, guiding sellers through our comprehensive onboarding journey from initial sign-up to successful activation

  • Data-Driven Prioritization: Leverage Excel and Salesforce to analyze seller profiles, create strategic reports, and identify the most promising business opportunities

  • Projects : Take ownership of improvement projects end to end. You'll get your hands dirty identifying pain points, spotting repetitive tasks ripe for automation, and driving solutions from idea to implementation with the help of your manager — not just flagging issues, but fixing them.

  • International Impact: Communicate directly with sellers across Europe and the US, building strong professional relationships that drive business growth

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • Seeking a 6-month full-time internship (Gap Year or End of Studies welcome)

  • Fluent English - you'll be the voice of Back Market to international sellers

  • Excel proficiency including pivot tables and data analysis capabilities

  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail - you'll manage high-volume, process-intensive workflows

  • Passionate about business development/sales with a keen eye for identifying opportunities

  • Structured approach to work with ability to prioritize effectively in fast-paced environments

Bonus Points:

  • French language skills

  • Salesforce experience or CRM familiarity

  • Previous commercial or e-commerce experience

  • Proactive mindset with initiative for process improvements

  • Additional European languages

Ideal Profile: We're looking for ambitious, friendly yet professional students who are genuinely excited about sales, business development, and e-commerce — and who don't just want to observe, but to build. The ideal candidate is curious about how processes work, quick to spot inefficiencies, and motivated to own solutions from start to finish. Whether you're taking a gap year or completing your studies, what matters most is your motivation, business acumen, and eagerness to make a real impact.

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: 6 months (until June 2027)

  • Schedule: Full-time (35H/week)

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Contract: Internship agreement from your French school required

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Skills fit interview with the direct manager (Reviewing the job description and missions, your CV and past experiences/projects)

  • Video-call HR Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist

  • Cultural fit interview with another person in the team

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

title: Compliance Officer / MLRO Switzerland & Liechtenstein
description:
Compliance Officer / MLRO - Switzerland & Liechtenstein

 

About Keyrock

 

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 180+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris, New York and Chicago.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

 

Mission statement

We are looking for an experienced and driven Compliance Officer and MLRO for our Switzerland and Liechtenstein based entities. You will join a dynamic and dedicated Group Compliance team, operating as a key member while focusing primarily on our Switzerland and Liechtenstein operational entities. This role offers an exciting opportunity to make a wider impact across the organization by working on broader, group-level projects, allowing you to contribute to the global compliance framework and help grow the group as a whole.

 

Job description

 

  • Ensuring compliance with all relevant laws and regulations applicable to Switzerland and Liechtenstein by developing and implementing the policies and procedures ;

  • Conducting compliance risk assessments and elaborating an annual compliance plan;

  • Developing and implementing a plan of second-line controls and conducting the tests;

  • Assessing future business activities to identify potential compliance risks;

  • Ensuring the firm’s policies and procedures are being communicated effectively to all relevant employees;

  • Ensuring the compliance trainings are effective and up to date;

  • Keeping abreast with regulatory changes and maintaining the policies and procedures up to date;

  • Collaborate with internal departments such as Trading Operations, Finance, Risk management, IT & Security, etc… to integrate compliance requirements into business processes.

  • Being responsible for oversight of Keyrock CH and LI compliance with its AML obligations and acting as a focal point for the firm’s AML activity (MLRO).

  • Carrying out the duties of a MLRO as per the AML/CTF Framework

  • Representing Keyrock CH and LI in all matters of money laundering prevention internally and externally;

  • Serving as a subject matter expert on AML/CTF matters, providing guidance and support to the compliance team and other departments;

  • Conducting regular audits and reviews to ensure compliance with AML/CTF requirements and internal policies

  • Drafting of compliance points of attention and recommendations and assisting the Group Head of Compliance or Group General Counsel (Group level) with management information reports;

 

Background and experience

  • Solid experience as a Compliance officer (2nd line of defense) in a regulated financial institution in Switzerland and/or Liechtenstein, ideally with exposure to MLRO responsibilities or similar

  • Experience in engaging with Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory authorities;

  • Excellent knowledge of financial regulations such as MiCAR, AML/CTF, market abuse , data privacy;

  • Understanding of the digital assets ecosystem is a major plus;

  • A relevant degree, preferably in business or law, is required;

  • Extensive experience in implementation of monitoring and control processes to support policies and procedures;

  • A compliance qualification for example ACAMS or a Masters in a related field would be an advantage;

 

Our recruitment philosophy

We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

Our offer

 

  • A competitive salary and benefits package

  • Annual Team Retreats: a yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities

  • Opportunity to work remotely

  • Fast-paced, highly intellectually stimulating working environment

  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

 

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

 

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

title: Field Sales Executive - South Texas
description:
About Tekmetric

Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.

Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.

Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.

Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.

Working the Tekmetric Way

At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.

We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.

Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.

Where We Work: At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection. We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.

What You’ll Do

As a Field Sales Executive, you will be responsible for executing the end-to-end sales motion within a defined territory, focusing on in-person engagement to land and expand customer accounts. Your activities will be critical to achieving a higher close rate, closing complex accounts that an inside sales motion alone might miss, and driving a higher gross and net customer retention.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Identify and define Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs), including new prospects with multiple locations and existing prospects to land and expand (e.g., Payments, Tekmetric Marketing, TireSuite, Motovisuals).
  • Identify prospects, qualify leads, and engage them via various channels, including in-person meetings and lunch-n-learns.
  • Set appointments, land new accounts, and expand them over time by selling additional products/services.
  • Where necessary, work with customer onboarding and customer success teams to safeguard initial investments and ensure the long-term value of newly acquired accounts.
  • Build stronger, in-person relationships, as this makes it harder for prospects to say 'no' compared to a virtual engagement.
  • Plan daily routes to minimize "windshield time" and optimize travel efficiency, as time spent traveling is time not selling. Route planning should be done in advance (e.g., 2 weeks) in collaboration with your manager/leader.
  • Manage and execute a defined sales cadence/sequence for prospect accounts (e.g., Call, Email, Visit, Email, Call).
  • Work in tandem with Channel Partner Managers (CPMs) in a POD structure to hold in-person demos for channel leads, which preserves partner trust and minimizes the sales cycle.
  • Manage the CRM by tracking and updating all activities directly in Salesforce.
  • Document key sales activities to ensure we understand what success looks like regarding touchpoints and time to close.
  • Track follow-ups, manage account/lead assignments, and maintain pipeline hygiene.
  • Accurately forecast sales to provide transparency and accountability.
  • Heavy documentation of key activities is required to help define activity-based KPIs that drive success and to serve as a template for scale-up.

This is an exciting and rewarding role for a strategic sales mind looking to help Tekmetic expand our reach further into the industry we love.

What You’ll Bring

  • A consistent track record as a top performer, meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Preferred 5+ years on the service side of the automotive industry (have industry knowledge, especially a strong understanding of what shop owners go through).
  • Minimum of 2+ years prior sales experience in B2B, SaaS preferred
  • Strong organizational, logistical, and planning skills for optimizing travel and managing last-minute schedule changes.
  • Effective communication in all forms (written, verbal, and in-person)
  • A self-starter attitude and ability to quickly build rapport with prospects.
  • Ability to manage a Tuesday–Thursday regional travel schedule to maximize face-to-face engagement with

Why You'll Love Working With Us

Health & Wellness That Have You Covered:

  • Enjoy the flexibility of remote work
  • Competitive base salaries that reflect your value.
  • Flexible PTO — No set number of days, just the trust to take the time you need. We genuinely encourage our team to disconnect and recharge.

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
😎 Our Culture

Quantum Metric's number one objective is happy people, diverse and inclusive culture. We’re passionate about empowering our people to become the best version of themselves, offering coaching and training programs designed to accelerate their career in whatever direction they choose.

As a remote-first company, we understand the importance of building an engaged, diverse, and fun place to work. We hold regular company-wide events, seasonal challenges, and Quantum Metric sponsored local outings when Zoom becomes too much. We also have a number of Employee Resource Groups that provide spaces to discuss, share, and reflect on topics that impact us both inside and outside of work - from being new to SaaS or navigating it as a first-time parent, to overcoming the barriers faced as Black, Hispanic, Asian American and Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander, LGBTQIA or other underrepresented backgrounds.

We are also passionate about the connections we build with our customers. You’ll not only work with some of the world’s most recognized brands, but build lasting relationships.

At Quantum Metric we value all types of experience and education and don’t expect you to meet every qualification for this position. We are most interested in the unique perspective you can bring and your ability to uphold our values of passion, persistence, and integrity.

🚀 About the Role

As a Strategic Account Executive at Quantum Metric, you will steward and grow a key industry territory, driving full-cycle “land-and-expand” sales into Fortune 500 accounts. We seek a results-oriented individual motivated by professional growth, impact, and high-performance rewards.

As a key member of our enterprise sales team, you will leverage enterprise SaaS sales expertise to engage diverse stakeholders—including C-suite executives and digital product leaders—to diagnose challenges, develop rigorous solutions, and quantify ROI. Our team is a fast-growing unit already partnered with market-leading enterprise organizations across North America. We provide a supportive, inclusive, and collaborative culture where talented professionals can grow, thrive, and make a significant impact.

🔧 Responsibilities

  • Strategic Account & Territory Development: Prioritize top-named accounts, execute strategic plans, and maintain a consistent pipeline
  • Quota Attainment: Consistently meet and exceed annual quota targets by identifying, qualifying, and closing new and expansion opportunities
  • Complex Sales Acumen: Navigate intricate sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, and complex organizational structures to accurately forecast & close deals
  • Consultative & Solution-Oriented: Establish trust through robust discovery; collaborate with internal partners to develop solutions that address customer challenges using Felix AI
  • Value-Driven Partnerships: Collaborate with prospective clients to build compelling business cases demonstrating tangible ROI and strategic advantages
  • Trusted Advisor Role: Cultivate strong stakeholder relationships pre-sale; post-sale, partner with delivery teams across kickoff meetings and major milestones to ensure long-term success.

💡 Requirements

  • Enterprise Expertise: Extensive experience in enterprise SaaS sales, typically gained over 8+ years
  • Proven Track Record: History of exceeding quotas and closing complex deals valued between $500k–$1M+
  • Relationship Management: Ability to build and maintain trust with senior stakeholders throughout long-term sales cycles
  • Analytical Skills: Experience developing data-driven business cases and demonstrating ROI
  • Methodology & Tools: Familiarity with enterprise sales methodologies (e.g., MEDPICC) and proficiency with CRM, prospecting, and AI tools
  • Communication: Exceptional presentation and negotiation skills with a focus on mutually beneficial outcomes.
  • Strategic Mindset: Strong business acumen and the ability to think critically in an entrepreneurial, rapidly growing environment

Compensation

Base: $155,000–$165,000 (OTE is double base; commissions are uncapped)

Additional Information

💻 Recruitment Process

Note: This interview process is subject to change. End stage candidates are also given the optional opportunity to meet with an Employee Resource Group Member if that is of interest.

- Recruiter Screen (30 minutes)

- Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes)

- Demo (60 minutes)
- Presentation (60 minutes)
- In-person interview (30-90 minutes, subject to interviewer availability)

- Chief Revenue Officer Interview (30 minutes)

- CEO Interview (30 minutes)

🏆 Perks and Benefits

This will be the best group that you ever work with! We support one another through obstacles and succeed as a team. Your hard work will be well rewarded. Most importantly, you'll be strapped to a technology rocket ship bound for greatness! Your success at Quantum Metric will be a milestone in your career.

Group benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance (99% Medical base plan paid by the Company)

FSA, DCFSA, and HSA accounts

Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)

Telehealth options

Voluntary Life & AD&D, STD, LTD, Critical Illness and Accident

Wellness Perks - discounts on a top-rated fitness app and Healthy Rewards program.

Discounts on Pet Insurance

401k (with employer match) and Options / Equity

13 company holidays

Unlimited Paid Time Off

Sick leave

Parental/Adoption Leave

In addition to our more traditional benefits, we also offer great perks, a flexible work environment, and numerous resources for professional development and team building.

Promotional opportunities

Rewards and recognition programs

Robust onboarding and training program

One-time stipend for work-at-home employees

Monthly business expense stipend

Flexible work environments

Employee Discount Program (Perks at Work)

Employee Referral Program

Lead Referral Program

MacBook and awesome swag delivered to your door

Encouraging and collaborative culture

RECHARGE PROGRAM (after 3 years, disconnect for 3 weeks, no email/slack)

🐉 About Quantum Metric

As a leader in digital analytics, Quantum Metric helps organizations put customers at the heart of everything they do. Providing a simplified approach to monitor, diagnose and optimize the digital journeys that matter most, the Quantum Metric platform offers in-depth customer understanding, quantified and tied to core business objectives.

Today, Quantum Metric captures insights from 50 percent of the world’s internet users, supporting nationally recognized brands in ecommerce and retail, travel, financial services and telecommunications.

Quantum Metric has been named to the Inc 5000 and the Deloitte 500 for the last six-consecutive years, and has made the Best Places to Work lists by Glassdoor, BuiltIn, Fast Company and Forbes.

If the above role seems like a match and you’re interested in joining a team of people with exceptional potential from diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences, we want to hear from you!

Quantum Metric reserves the right to change, edit, and add duties and responsibilities of all job descriptions at any time, at its sole discretion, and to notify the respective employee accordingly.

Quantum Metric will only provide offers of employment and all communications regarding employment from an official @quantummetric.com email address and/or LinkedIn inMail. Quantum does not recruit via channels such as WhatsApp or Telegram, and will not ask for a candidate’s sensitive information and/or any upfront fees/costs during the job application process. title: Enterprise Sales Engineer - Rockies
description:
As an Enterprise Sales Engineer, you'll partner with Sales to help customers understand the value of Datadog and how it solves their most important technical and business challenges. You'll lead technical evaluations, deliver compelling demos, and guide customers through the journey from discovery to successful adoption.

You'll act as a trusted advisor, bridging business goals with technical solutions, and play a key role in winning new business and expanding existing accounts.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the sales process in partnership with Account Executives by leading and shaping the technical strategy across opportunities from PG to Closed Won
  • Lead customer discovery to uncover technical challenges, business goals, and success criteria, then translate those needs into tailored Datadog solutions
  • Deliver engaging product demos, technical presentations, and workshops that connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes
  • Project manage technical evaluations (POVs) end-to-end: scoping use cases and requirements, defining success criteria, building a project plan with clear timelines, and holding all participants accountable to the process
  • Identify and cultivate technical champions within customer accounts, empowering them to advocate for Datadog adoption and drive consensus internally
  • Participat e actively in structured product and engineering field feedback sessions, serving as the technical voice of the customer to help shape product direction
  • Maintain operational excellence by ensuring activity, deal progress, and customer interactions are accurately documented and up to date in related systems
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Support, and GTM teams to address customer needs and resolve technical blockers

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a technical customer-facing role within an enterprise environment
  • Skilled at navigating multi-stakeholder environments and adapting communication style to technical, business, and executive audiences
  • Proficient background in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM/tracing, security, developer experience, observability
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences
  • A consultative approach to problem-solving and customer engagement
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Growth mindset by embracing change and AI tools
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

  • Best-in-breed onboarding
  • Generous global benefits
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

title: Managing Consultant, Nursing
description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Managing Consultant, Nursing

Why We Have This Role

Nursing leadership and clinical workflows directly determine patient outcomes, care connection, and operational performance across health systems. In this leadership role, you will apply deep clinical nursing background and data analytics to guide healthcare organizations through complex system redesign, clinical process improvement, and cultural change. You will lead project teams, direct end-to-end consulting engagements, and partner directly with client stakeholders to solve high-stakes operational and care delivery challenges. Working alongside senior practice leadership, you will coach nursing teams, implement proven patient experience best practices, and build lasting, high-value client relationships. If you are a seasoned nursing leader driven to combine clinical expertise with advanced analytics to elevate care delivery nationwide, this role offers the perfect platform.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Combines Clinical Depth & Data Mastery: Translates complex clinical and operational data assets into actionable system designs and nursing strategies.
  • Leads and Empowers Teams: Effectively manages project teams, coordinates resources, and delegates efficiently to achieve high-quality engagement outcomes.
  • Designs Connection-Focused Strategies: Leverages nursing expertise to implement processes that help nurses connect deeply with patients and improve care delivery.
  • Communicates with Influence: Builds immediate credibility across all levels of client management, effectively conveying risks, strategies, and solutions.
  • Masterful Trainer & Coach: Delivers high-engagement training and knowledge transfer to elevate clinical staff performance and process adoption.
  • Drives Execution Excellence: Manages complex project timelines, budgets, scope, and deliverables with agility under pressure and competing priorities.

How You’ll Grow

  • Step into engagement leadership, directing multi-faceted consulting teams and managing complex health system projects.
  • Expand your strategic consulting repertoire by designing scalable, system-wide nursing and patient care frameworks.
  • Deepen your executive presence by partnering directly with health system leaders to shape nursing strategy and organizational culture.
  • Gain exposure to advanced healthcare analytics, payer metrics, and nationwide clinical improvement methodologies alongside practice leaders.

Things You’ll Do

  • Direct End-to-End Consulting Engagements: Manage project scope, budgets, timelines, and outcomes while directing project teams to deliver world-class clinical consulting.
  • Design Systems for Nursing Excellence: Partner with clients to complete data analyses, process redesigns, and clinical workflows that strengthen care connection and operational efficiency.
  • Facilitate Clinical Training & Coaching: Deliver interactive, high-impact training programs that embed patient experience best practices and sustainable process improvements across nursing teams.
  • Synthesize Advanced Healthcare Analytics: Construct and lead analytical reviews across payer metrics, denial rates, and clinical behavior assessments to deliver clear executive recommendations.
  • Build High-Trust Client Relationships: Serve as the primary point of contact on engagement streams, establishing credibility and generating strong client satisfaction.
  • Optimize Resource Delegation: Coordinate internal and client resources effectively using structured project management tools and work plans.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • 10+ years of nursing experience with proven success designing clinical systems, processes, and care connection strategies.
  • Demonstrated track record in training, coaching, and leading performance improvement initiatives within healthcare settings.
  • Strong data analytics skills combined with advanced proficiency in MS and/or Google tools, i.e. Excel, Sheets, Powerpoint.
  • Experience using dashboards, reporting, KPIs, quality metrics, Power BI, Epic reporting, workforce analytics, HCAHPS, patient experience, retention, and/or operational data.
  • Experience in a Magnet®-designated healthcare organization with a focus on professional training, education, or leadership development (strongly preferred).
  • Management/strategic consulting experience in healthcare environments (preferred).
  • Bachelor’s degree required; ability to travel up to 75%.

What You Should Know About This Team

  • Clinical Mission Driven: We sit at the intersection of clinical excellence and data analytics, helping health systems transform nursing workflows and patient connection.
  • Collaborative Leadership Culture: You will lead project teams while working directly with Associate Principals, Principals, and Partners in an environment that prioritizes team growth and shared ownership.
  • Focus on Practical Innovation: We translate complex data sets into practical tools, education, and workflow changes that make real-world impacts for frontline care teams.
  • High-Trust Client Partnerships: We serve as embedded, trusted advisors to health system leadership, building long-term relationships through proven engagement outcomes.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • We participate in personalized Career Action Planning. You will work with your manager to design a plan based on your life experiences, values, and career aspirations (inside and outside Qualtrics) that helps you achieve your career goals at Qualtrics.
  • Qualtrics pays 100% of the healthcare benefit premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Variable allowances for wellness, meals, transportation, and more.

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote

Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.

Sign up for exclusive access to content created with you in mind and get the scoop on what we have going on at Qualtrics - upcoming events, behind the scenes stories from the team, interview tips, hot jobs, and more. No spam - we promise! You'll hear from us two times a month max with fresh, totally tailored info - so be sure to stay connected as you explore your best role and company fit.
