title: Financial Services Representative
description:
Position Summary:

Financial Services Representatives support learners at important moments in their education by helping them address payment concerns and stay on track with their programs. In this role, you’ll connect with learners by phone, listen to understand what is affecting their ability to pay, explain account status and available options, and help them take a clear next step. You’ll also help learners who call to make a payment. This position is a good fit for someone who enjoys helping others, can speak confidently about payments, and stays calm and focused in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment. Most of your day is spent handling calls rather than email, chat, or ticket queues. A typical day may include about 125 inbound and outbound call activities, including unanswered calls and voicemails; inbound volume may average around 70 calls. Call volume varies

Compensation:

$17 per hour, plus performance incentives. Incentive amounts vary based on the program and results and are not guaranteed.

Location and Schedule:

US-based, 100% remote role. Monday-Friday from 11:30 AM-8:00 PM Eastern time.

Training Period:

The first month focuses on inbound calls. Dialer training is introduced in the second month so you can build confidence before adding outbound calls. Performance measures are introduced gradually during the first four months as you learn the role.

Ongoing Schedule:

Inbound calls are prioritized, with outbound auto-dialer calls handled as availability allows Dialer activity can include unanswered calls and hang-ups. You’ll need to be ready to respond when a learner answers and keep a steady, professional approach throughout the day. Voluntary overtime may be available during busier periods.

Essential Job Functions:

Support learners through inbound calls and outbound auto-dialer campaigns, prioritizing inbound calls. Ask thoughtful questions to understand each learner’s situation and discuss payment options when appropriate. Explain account status and potential consequences of falling further behind, including late fees, loss of study access, or referral to a collection agency. Discuss available options within department guidelines which may include changing the payment due date, an eligible deferment, or a late-fee waiver. Process payments, document account interactions accurately, and select the appropriate call disposition. Follow privacy, call-recording disclosure, do-not-call, and other department procedures. Meet service, quality, schedule-adherence, and performance expectations, and contribute to team goals. Work with team leads and peers to resolve questions and support a collaborative remote team.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

High school diploma or GED required. Collections experience preferred; call center or customer service experience is also valuable. Direct collections experience is not required. Strong communication, active listening, probing, and problem-solving skills. Professional phone presence and the ability to stay calm and empathetic during challenging conversations. Comfort handling a high volume of calls, asking for payment, and working toward clear performance goals. Strong computer skills, including the ability to navigate multiple systems and Microsoft Outlook. Dependable, punctual, open to coaching, and willing to learn as part of a team.

Working Conditions & Hiring Process:

Role Assessment: Candidates will be required to complete a role-specific assessment as the first step in the hiring process. Assessment results will be used to evaluate alignment with the position and determine next steps in the process. U.S. Work Location Requirement: All employees must reside in and perform work within the United States. We do not support international remote work arrangements for this role. Travel Expectations: While this is a remote position, occasional travel may be required for team meetings, company events, conferences, summits, etc. Candidates must be willing and able to travel as needed. On-Camera Work Environment: We operate in a highly collaborative, remote, on-camera culture. Employees are expected to be on camera during meetings unless extenuating circumstances apply. Recorded Video Interviews: All video interviews conducted during the hiring process will be recorded to support internal hiring consistency and process improvement. Background Checks: Employment with Penn Foster Group is contingent upon successfully completing applicable pre-employment screening requirements, which may include verification of employment history, education, and criminal background, where permitted by law. Identity Verification (Form I-9): As part of our onboarding process, all hires must complete employment eligibility verification in compliance with federal law. This includes remote Form I-9 verification, which may require an in-person identity verification step with an authorized representative.

Working Conditions & Hiring Process

U.S. Work Location Requirement: All employees must reside and perform work within the United States. International remote work arrangements are not supported for this role.

Travel Expectations: This is a remote position, though occasional travel may be required for team meetings, company events, conferences, summits, and similar activities. Candidates must be willing and able to travel as needed.

On-Camera Work Environment: Penn Foster Group operates in a highly collaborative, remote, on-camera culture. Employees are expected to be on camera during meetings unless extenuating circumstances apply.

Recorded Video Interviews: Video interviews conducted during the hiring process will be recorded to support internal hiring consistency and process improvement.

Background Checks: Employment with Penn Foster Group is contingent upon successfully completing applicable pre-employment screening requirements. These may include verification of employment history, education, and criminal background, where permitted by law.

Identity Verification (Form I-9): As part of the onboarding process, all hires must complete employment eligibility verification in compliance with federal law. This includes remote Form I-9 verification, which may require an in-person identity verification step with an authorized representative.

About Us:

At Penn Foster Group, we are transforming online learning to help learners by uniting Penn Foster, CareerStep, Ashworth College, James Madison High School, the New York Institute of Photography, the New York Institute of Art and Design, and other education platforms. Together, we create an accelerated path to greater economic mobility through real-world skills and knowledge that enable them to achieve long-term success in the workplaces of the future. Our history dates back to 1890 when our founder, Thomas Foster, pioneered distance education by offering training by mail for coal miners to get the necessary skills for safer jobs. Today, with the partners who use our education and training programs, we continue that mission of providing accessible training and education for in-demand skills and are building a workforce that’s prepared for the future job market.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

We strive toward Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Penn Foster Group by intentionally building teams that are diverse – in identities, lived experiences, and ideas to create a culture where people feel connected to each other and have a sense of belonging. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion because it is the foundation that enables us to achieve what we set out to do as an organization – from maximizing the number of learners who can reach their goals while giving them the kinds of experiences we want them to have, to becoming the type of company we want to work in.

What We Offer:

We offer a robust benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, flexible spending, generous paid time off, sponsored volunteer opportunities, a 401K with a company match, plus free access to all of our online programs.

title: Part-Time Customer Retention Representative
description:
At Globe Life, we are committed to empowering our employees with the support and opportunities they need to succeed at every stage of their career. We take pride in fostering a caring and innovative culture that enables us to collectively grow and overcome challenges in a connected, collaborative, and mutually respectful environment that calls us to help Make Tomorrow Better.

Role Overview:

Could you be our next Customer Retention Representative? Globe Life is looking for a Customer Retention Representative to join the team!


In this role, you will be responsible for conserving business on behalf of the Company. You’ll be a vital part of a dedicated, professional team. Representatives play a key role in ensuring that customers who call to cancel are helped understand the importance of keeping their coverage and receive policy maintenance.


***This is a remote/work-from-home position with AM and PM shifts available

What You Will Do (All Shifts)

  • Answer questions regarding coverage, premium, and other policy information.
  • Make outbound calls to existing policyholders to retain, resell, and recover lapsed or delinquent policies.
  • Recommend appropriate coverage adjustments based on individual policyholder needs.
  • Record and maintain accurate policyholder information for reporting and transactional purposes.
  • Communicate clearly and empathetically, adapting your style to each customer's needs.
  • Follow up with customers to confirm understanding and satisfaction with proposed solutions.
  • Maintain discretion and tact; extensive telephone contact required.
  • Work independently and exercise sound judgment.
  • Stay current on life insurance products, policy features, and company procedures.
  • Meet or exceed contact center KPIs include call volume, retention rate, first call resolution, adherence, call quality, and attendance expectations.
  • Bilingual (Spanish) hourly pay differential.

AM Shift – Additional Responsibilities

  • Handle inbound calls from policyholders requesting cancellations and explore retention options.
  • Proactively contact customers with lapsed policies to discuss payment solutions.

PM Shift – Additional Responsibilities

  • Make outbound calls to collect delinquent premium payments.
  • Compose business letters and communicate effectively through written and verbal communication.

What You Can Bring:

  • High school diploma or equivalent is required.
  • Basic Microsoft Office Skills, including Word, Excel, and Outlook, are required.
  • A minimum typing speed of 30 wpm is required.
  • Experience in a call center environment is preferred.
  • Some insurance and/or sales experience is preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to solve complex policyholder issues with a positive attitude.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and work well under pressure.
  • Knowledge of life and/or health insurance terminology preferred.

Applicable To All Employees of Globe Life Family of Companies:

  • Reliable and predictable attendance of your assigned shift.

  • Ability to work full time and/or part time based on the position specifications.

How Globe Life Will Support You:

Looking to continue your career in an environment that values your contribution and invests in your growth? We've curated a benefits package that helps to ensure that you don’t just work, but thrive at Globe Life:

  • Competitive compensation designed to reflect your expertise and contribution.

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans because your well-being is fundamental to your performance.

  • Robust life insurance benefits and retirement plans, including company-matched 401k and pension plan.

  • Paid holidays and time off to support a healthy work-life balance.

  • Parental leave to help our employees welcome their new additions.

  • Subsidized all-in-one subscriptions to support your fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep goals.

  • Company-paid counseling for assistance with mental health, stress management, and work-life balance.

  • Continued education reimbursement eligibility and company-paid FLMI and ICA courses to grow your career.

  • Discounted Texas Rangers tickets for a proud visit to Globe Life Field.

Opportunity awaits! Invest in your professional legacy, realize your path, and see the direct impact you can make in a workplace that celebrates and harnesses your unique talents and perspectives to their fullest potential. At Globe Life, your voice matters.

  • Understanding and ability to explain Cost Basis, Tax documents, IRA (Individual Retirement Account) RMD (Required Minimum Distribution) withdrawals and early withdrawal penalties

  • Influence – Authority to impact Investment Advice in accordance with the BIS offer and applicable securities regulations

Knowledge and Skills

  • Series 7 and 66 or (7, 63 and 65) and insurance licenses (life and health)
  • U4 clear background check requirements

Why you’ll love growing your careerhere

  • Customizable benefits, and performance bonuses

  • As North American’s eighth largest bank serving customers for 200+ years, connect with thousands of employees to build your professional network and explore more opportunities

$55,000.00 - $110,000.00

Pay Type:

Salaried

Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role, and may include a commission structure. Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Front End Developer
description:
Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range: $85,000â$100,000


About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

title: Product Engineer, Shop
description:
ABOUT INSIFY

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. 

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.


About the role

You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together.

You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth.


What you'll be doing
  • Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business
  • Continuously and relentlessly seeking opportunities to turn new product demands into platform capabilities and features that scale across countries and insurance product lines
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • 3+ years building complex web applications and services, with real production ownership
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your direct stack to get to results, be that data / backend / frontend
  • You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt
  • Strong fundamentals in domain-driven design & service oriented architecture
    • Not all of the above are hard requirements. If you're strong on most of these and eager to grow into the rest, we'd still love to hear from you.

    Nice to have
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Strong observability instincts. You know where things will break, and can help others learn that too

    • Our stack

    TypeScript across the board, running on AWS (IaaC), in a single monorepo. If you have not worked with all of it, that is fine. We care more about how you reason about systems than about which tools you have used before.


    We offer
  • Competitive compensation that reflects responsibility and impact. For this role the range is €65,000 to €85,000.
  • Trust and autonomy. You'll have real ownership, room to make decisions, and space to shape your role as Insify evolves.
  • Hybrid working. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year working from abroad, and 25 holiday days.
  • Pension. We contribute 6% for you.
  • Alleo budget. €50 net a month to spend on whatever you want, from the gym to takeaway. It rolls over if you don't use it.
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs, and coaching to go with them.
  • A central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, whiteboards, and Friday drinks.
  • Hardware & setup. A high-spec MacBook Pro, high-res monitors at the office, and comfortable ergonomic seating.

title: Ehrenamt · remote · 4–6 Std./Woche: Projektleiter / Projektmanager (m/w/d)
description:
Du hast Freude daran, Ideen in konkrete Projekte zu verwandeln, Menschen zusammenzubringen und Vorhaben von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung zu begleiten? Vielleicht bringst du bereits Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, in der Organisationsentwicklung oder in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Teams mit.

Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für spannende Projekte mit gesellschaftlicher Wirkung. Eines davon ist DEHIB Masterminds, unser Qualifizierungs- und Leadership-Programm, das ehrenamtliches Engagement mit fachlicher Weiterbildung, Persönlichkeitsentwicklung und praktischer Führungserfahrung verbindet.

Du musst nicht jede Projektmanagementmethode beherrschen. Viel wichtiger sind uns Eigeninitiative, Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, Menschen für gemeinsame Ziele zu begeistern

Gleich vorweg: Das ist ein Ehrenamt

Die Aufgabe ist unbezahlt und begründet kein Arbeitsverhältnis. Wir suchen Menschen, die ihre Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Ideen einbringen möchten, weil sie gesellschaftlich etwas bewegen und gleichzeitig selbst Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.

Wer wir sind

Der Deutsche Hilfsbund e.V. (DEHIB) bündelt Hilfsorganisationen und bringt sie mit Menschen aus Wirtschaft, Politik und Wissenschaft zusammen, damit soziales Engagement mehr bewirkt.

Wir verbinden Verbände, schaffen professionelle Strukturen und bauen bundesweit eine Plattform für gesellschaftliche Wirkung auf.

Mit Projekten wie DEHIB Masterminds entwickeln wir innovative Ansätze, um ehrenamtliches Engagement zu professionalisieren, Kompetenzen sichtbar zu machen und Menschen neue Entwicklungsperspektiven zu eröffnen.

Damit aus diesen Ideen erfolgreiche Projekte werden, brauchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und dich.

Deine Aufgaben

· Projekte eigenständig steuern: Projekte von der ersten Planung über die operative Umsetzung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss begleiten

· DEHIB Masterminds mitgestalten: Beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unseres Qualifizierungs- und Leadership-Programms mitwirken

· Projektplanung und Organisation: Ziele, Arbeitspakete, Meilensteine, Zuständigkeiten und Zeitpläne definieren und koordinieren

· Teams und Beteiligte zusammenbringen: Die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Fachbereichen, Ehrenamtlichen, externen Partnern und Projektbeteiligten organisieren

· Fortschritte im Blick behalten: Aufgaben nachhalten, Herausforderungen frühzeitig erkennen und gemeinsam praktikable Lösungen entwickeln

· Kommunikation und Abstimmung: Projektbesprechungen vorbereiten, Ergebnisse dokumentieren und die zuständigen Verantwortlichen regelmäßig über den Projektstatus informieren

· Neue Ideen entwickeln: Bestehende Prozesse verbessern und eigene Vorschläge für weitere Projekte und ihre Umsetzung einbringen

Du musst nicht alles gleichzeitig übernehmen. Gemeinsam legen wir fest, welche Projekte zu deinen Erfahrungen und Interessen passen und welche Verantwortung du eigenständig übernehmen möchtest.

Was du mitbringst

· Freude daran, Projekte zu organisieren, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam Ergebnisse zu erzielen

· Idealerweise Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, in der Projektkoordination, Organisationsentwicklung oder Vereinsarbeit

· Fähigkeit, komplexere Aufgaben zu strukturieren, Prioritäten zu setzen und unterschiedliche Beteiligte zusammenzubringen

· Selbstständige, lösungsorientierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

· Kommunikationsstärke, Teamgeist und ein gutes Gespür für unterschiedliche Interessen

· Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen; Microsoft 365 (Teams, Planner, SharePoint, Outlook) ist von Vorteil

· Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

· Bereitschaft, uns regelmäßig etwa 5–8 Stunden pro Woche zu unterstützen

Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss oder eine formale Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung ist nicht erforderlich. Entscheidend ist, dass du Projekte mit Engagement, Struktur und Verantwortungsbewusstsein voranbringst.

Was wir dir bieten

Sinn & Gemeinnutz

· Deine Arbeit hilft, dass unsere ehrenamtlichen Teams, Gremien und Verantwortlichen wirkungsvoll zusammenarbeiten und gesellschaftliches Engagement gestärkt wird.

· Du arbeitest mit Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und gesellschaftlich etwas bewegen wollen.

Exklusives Netzwerk

· Zugang zu einem wachsenden Netzwerk aus Wirtschaft, Politik, Wissenschaft und Non-Profit-Organisationen

· Austausch mit Unternehmer:innen, Führungskräften und Expert:innen ganz unterschiedlicher Fachrichtungen

· Zugriff auf das Know-how unserer angeschlossenen Organisationen und Kooperationspartner

Gestaltung & Verantwortung

· Du übernimmst eigene Aufgaben, gestaltest organisatorische Abläufe mit und bringst deine Ideen ein

· Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Chief of Staff und Einblick in das COO Office und die Gremienarbeit

· Möglichkeit, schrittweise mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen

Entwicklung & Referenz

· Du entwickelst deine Fähigkeiten in Projektkoordination, Kommunikation und digitaler Zusammenarbeit weiter

· Eine starke Referenz: Mitarbeit in einer zentralen Organisationsfunktion einer bundesweit tätigen Organisation

· Qualifiziertes Ehrenamtszeugnis und Tätigkeitsnachweis

So arbeiten wir zusammen

· Komplett remote mit Microsoft 365, deine Zeit teilst du dir weitgehend flexibel ein

· Klare Absprachen: Aufgaben, Zeitumfang und feste Termine halten wir in einer kurzen Ehrenamtsvereinbarung fest

· Strukturierte Einarbeitung, Chief of Staff als feste Ansprechperson und eine Kennenlernphase von zwei bis drei Monaten

· Corporate Benefits

So meldest du dich – ganz unkompliziert

Kein Anschreiben, kein Bewerbungsmarathon: Schreib uns in drei, vier Sätzen, welche Erfahrungen du mit Projekten mitbringst, was dir bei der Projektarbeit besonders liegt und warum dich dieses Ehrenamt reizt.

Danach lernen wir uns in einem kurzen virtuellen Gespräch kennen und schauen gemeinsam, welche Projekte zu dir passen.

Du möchtest nicht nur über gute Ideen sprechen, sondern sie gemeinsam mit anderen verwirklichen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Mehr zu unserem Projekt DEHIB Masterminds: https://masterminds.dehib.com/

Hi there! We are Testlio, a global software testing company with its own freelance network. Our freelancers test apps from companies across the globe. Testlio is a great place for people who value the freedom and flexibility of remote work.

At the moment, we are looking for freelance software testers based in Réunion or Monaco to participate in a software testing project for one of our clients, a globally know premier sporting league based out of the United States. We're currently in the process of testing out their app and subscription flow, and we'd love to welcome you as part of the testing team.

Benefits of being a freelancer at Testlio

  • Schedule: You can create your schedule and work on other testing runs that interest you.
  • Location: Testlio is a 100% remote company. Seriously, you can work from the coffee shop, your home, or while waiting for class.
  • Growth: You’ll be testing global-scale mobile apps and have the chance to boost your skills and grow your career.
  • Payment: You are paid by the hour, not by the bug. This means you get paid even if you did not uncover any bugs.

Requirements

  • Age: You have to be at least 18 years old.
  • Location: Must be physically located in Réunion or Monaco. The use of a VPN is prohibited.
  • Language: Must at least be comfortable speaking English.
  • Availability: Approximately 1h total for the setup + 90 minutes for the testing task, spread over a couple of days.
  • Devices: Laptop/ PC
  • Experience: No experience needed, we can provide training and instructions.

What does testing look like?

  • Type of testing: Payments testing.
  • Type of work: You will be asked to test out our client's subscription flow to make sure that it works accurately in your country.
  • Tasks: For this workspace, we will be validating our client's overall subscription flow. The workspace will be divided into 3 parts:
    • You will be invited to participate in a paid project onboarding, where you can check the details and documentation prior to testing
    • You will receive a pre-payment from us that will be used in the next stage of the workspace, approximately $20 - $25 USD.
    • You will be asked to use the pre-payment amount to help us test our client's subscription purchase.
  • Pay rate: $18 USD / h.
  • Payment: Payment will be made via PayPal or Payoneer.

How to start?

  1. Fill out the questionnaire. A member of our Recruitment Team will contact you with the next steps via email.
  2. If you are not a match with our requirements visit our Community page instead to find out more about how you can participate in other projects.

If you have any questions or need help, please contact Opportunities@testlio.com using the code FRENCHPAYMENTS in the Subject line/email body so we can quickly identify your request.

Once you are ready, please fill out the initial application below. Those who meet the requirements will receive further information to participate in this paid testing opportunity.

title: Spanish (Spain) to English Pharmacovigilance Linguist
description:
About Welo Life Sciences

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications. welolifesciences.com

About the Role

We are looking for experienced Spanish (Spain) to English (GB or US) linguists to support a high-volume, fast-turnaround pharmacovigilance program for a leading global pharmaceutical company. Work involves translating and reviewing safety and regulatory content, including adverse event reports and related clinical documentation, with strict turnaround times and deadlines.

This is an ongoing freelance engagement with daily volumes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate Pharmacovigilance and/or Clinical-regulatory content from Spanish into English.
  • Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content.
  • Perform Copy Edit review of translated/post-edited content for accuracy, tone, and consistency.
  • Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times on time-sensitive safety content.

Requirements

  • Degree in translation, linguistics or languages studies or an equivalent degree that includes significant
    translation training.
  • Minimum 2 years of professional experience translating medical documentation, specificially with experience and knowledge in Pharmacovigilance and/or Clinical-Regulatory content.
  • Experience translating pharmacovigilance content preferred: SAE/AE (serious and non-serious adverse events), PSURs, SUSARs, ICSRs, DSURs, Risk Management Plans (RMP).
  • Alternatively, experience translating regulatory or clinical documents: medical reports, protocols, synopses, ICF, discharge reports, study reports, SmPC, PIL, or medical literature.
  • Great daily availability: this program requires consistent daily capacity and is not suited to part-time schedules.
  • Strong Spanish proficiency; native level of English preferred but not mandatory.
  • Experience with XTM or similar CAT tools.
  • Reliable, deadline-driven, and flexible, able to commit to fast turnaround times with no extensions.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare professional (HCP) background: nurse or physician preferred, especially with emergency room experience. Other HCP backgrounds also welcome.
  • Willingness to commit to daily and/or weekend availability.

Tools & Systems

  • CAT tool: XTM, client-provided license; onboarding and connector setup provided after onboarding.

Before Applying

Please note there will be an assessment as part of our onboarding and quality procedure, please only apply if you're willing to complete our assessment.

Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your Life Sciences and Medical translation experience, including years of experience specifically in Life Sciences, the document types you’ve translated, CAT tool you've used, and relevant details also your contact information (email AND phone number).

Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global

We look forward to receiving your application!

Role Description

Dropbox is seeking a highly organized and strategic Legal Operations Associate to join our Legal team. This individual will play a critical role in supporting the operational infrastructure that underpins our legal function. You will manage and optimize multiple legal systems, partner cross-functionally with internal teams, and serve as a key driver of efficiency and innovation across the legal organization.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience in legal operations, is technically proficient in legal platforms like JSM, Confluence, Ironclad and legal AI tooling, like Spellbook, and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced tech environment. This role is highly visible and provides a unique opportunity to shape how Dropbox’s Legal team operates today and scales for tomorrow.

Responsibilities

  • Design and lead legal team workflows, policies, and processes to improve efficiency.
  • Implement and manage legal technology tools (e.g., CLM, eBilling, matter management).
  • Drive legal department KPIs, reporting, and dashboards to measure performance and value.
  • Support the rollout of Legal’s front door in Jira Service Management and the onboarding of additional Legal teams, including testing changes, documenting configurations, and training users.
  • Oversee outside counsel and legal vendor engagements, onboarding, and billing.
  • Manage the legal team’s tech stack and collaborate with IT as needed.
  • Partner with IT, Finance, Procurement, Compliance, and other key teams on operational initiatives.
  • Ensure smooth communication between Legal and business stakeholders.
  • Partner with Legal teams to translate process needs into practical configurations and refine workflows based on user feedback and request trends.
  • Coordinate with CIT and the Atlassian team for platform guidance, troubleshooting, integrations, and changes requiring broader technical support.
  • Maintain centralized repositories for contracts, templates, policies, and legal knowledge.
  • Help maintain Legal’s Confluence knowledge base, working with subject-matter owners to organize approved guidance and support self-service and AI-assisted responses.
  • Lead or support legal projects from planning to execution, including process improvement and change adoption.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and implement solutions to reduce manual workload.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in legal operations, strong track record for project management, or operations roles within a legal department or law firm.
  • Tech industry experience and familiarity with commercial transactions strongly preferred.
  • Background experience with legal systems and technologies such as JSM, Confluence, Ironclad, Spellbook, and Brightflag knowledge are a plus, but not required.
  • Strong track record for project management and process optimization.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Eagerness to learn new things and ability to navigate complicated and nuanced issues.
  • Familiarity with contracting and procurement processes, as well as with negotiating, drafting and advising clients on commercial contracts is a plus but not required.
  • Familiarity with knowledge management, content organization and access controls.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into system configurations, troubleshoot issues and document changes.
  • BA/BS from a top university and excellent academic credentials.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong preference for this candidate to have previously worked in tech and virtual first — to understand the fast paced style of collaborating quickly, being agile, embracing change, and knowing how to obtain urgent approvals and input.
  • Hands-on JSM administration experience, including configuring and testing forms, fields, queues, workflows, routing or automation, and reporting.
  • Familiarity with team-managed JSM projects and working within shared platform standards.
  • Experience with Slack-based intake, Rovo or other AI-assisted knowledge and workflow tools.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

title: Freelance Copywriter, Pregnancy & Baby
description:
Who We Are

Good Inside is redefining parenting - not as something that should “just come naturally,” but as a skill to learn and practice. Founded by Dr. Becky Kennedy and Dr. Erica Belsky, we combine sturdy leadership with innovative technology to give parents personalized guidance, AI-powered support, and a global community.

Our mission: help parents raise resilient, confident kids in a changing world. We’ve already reached millions, and we’re just getting started. We’re refining our product and expanding our reach to empower even more families.

We’re looking for bold, high-ownership problem-solvers who want to build something new, tackle big challenges, and be at the forefront of change.

The Engagement

We're engaging an independent Copywriter, Pregnancy & Baby to help bring Good Inside to expecting and new parents through compelling, thoughtful copy.

Projects will include paid social, emails to members and non-members, blog posts, editorial content, partnership campaigns, and landing pages. We'll share a brief for each project with the goal, audience, and timeline, and you'll decide how to approach the work.

We're looking for someone who deeply understands this space and has written for it professionally for multiple clients or brands. You know the questions, emotions, and decisions that come with pregnancy and life with a baby, and how to write about them with warmth, clarity, and credibility.

You bring the expertise to take a brief and deliver polished copy using your own process. We care about the results, not how or when you get there.

Project Scope

  • Write Across Channels
    Deliver copy for paid social, member and non-member emails, blog posts, editorial content, partnerships, and landing pages. Additional project types can be added by mutual agreement.
  • Connect With Expecting and New Parents
    Bring your expertise in pregnancy and early parenthood to each project. Deliver copy that makes parents feel understood, answers real questions, and builds trust without leaning on fear or guilt.
  • Own Your Process
    Turn a project brief into finished work using your own research, drafting, and working methods. Ask focused questions up front, then deliver by the agreed deadline.
  • Bring Ideas to the Work
    Pitch strong hooks, fresh angles, and thoughtful concepts, drawing on your knowledge of the audience.
  • Match the Brand Voice
    Deliver copy that fits Good Inside's voice and brand guidelines. Our experts review content on sensitive or medical topics before publication.
  • Revisions and Results
    Each project includes revision rounds based on our consolidated feedback. Where available, we'll share performance data you can use to sharpen future projects.

What We're Looking For

  • An experienced copywriter with a strong portfolio in the pregnancy, baby, parenting, or maternal health space. Direct experience writing about pregnancy and babies is essential
  • Deeply familiar with the needs, concerns, and everyday experiences of expecting and new parents
  • A versatile writer who can move from a paid social hook to an email to a substantive blog post
  • An established independent writer who can take a brief and turn it into polished work
  • Comfortable scoping projects, setting timelines, and making creative decisions with the information available
  • A clear, thoughtful writer who balances empathy and credibility with marketing goals
  • Organized and reliable at managing multiple projects and deadlines
  • Open to feedback, with strong ownership of your deliverables

Bonus if you:

  • Have experience with membership or subscription businesses
  • Have written for expert-led brands or translated expert guidance into accessible consumer content
  • Have experience using performance insights to improve paid social and email copy

Engagement Details

  • Rate: $60–70 per hour, invoiced monthly and paid within 30 days
  • Estimated volume: roughly 15–20 hours per week, depending on project flow. This is an estimate, not a set schedule.
  • Your own schedule and location, with occasional in-person sessions in Midtown Manhattan when a project calls for it
  • A non-exclusive engagement: you're free to work with other clients

Equal Employment Opportunity

Good Inside is an equal opportunity employer and as such, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

We are dedicated to growing a diverse team of highly talented people. As much as we believe in focusing on the parent behind the parenting and the child behind the behavior, we believe in focusing on the person behind the job. We’re dedicated to building a workplace where we give each other the strategies, support, and space we each need to thrive—believing in and bringing out the good inside of everyone..

If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, whether it be alternate forms of material, accessible meeting rooms, etc., please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

title: Life Sciences Research Scientist (PhD): Wet Lab & Computational Biology
description:
Job Title: Life Sciences Research Scientist (PhD): Wet Lab & Computational Biology

Job Type: Contractor

Location: Remote(Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Design and write challenging, expert-level scientific problems in the life sciences, with clear, verifiable solutions.
  2. Review and evaluate AI model outputs for scientific accuracy, rigor, and depth of reasoning, catching subtle errors that non-specialists would miss.
  3. Develop detailed rubrics and reference answers grounded in primary literature and established experimental and computational methodology.
  4. Apply your domain expertise in areas such as genomics, transcriptomics and single-cell/spatial omics, epigenomics, proteomics and metabolomics, microbiome and metagenomics, structural biology, drug discovery, systems biology, and clinical/translational research.
  5. Bridge experimental and computational perspectives: assess whether a proposed experiment, analysis pipeline, or interpretation is scientifically sound.
  6. Provide clear written explanations of your reasoning so other experts can follow and validate it.
  7. Meet quality standards through iterative feedback and peer review.

Required Qualifications (MUST)

  1. Completed PhD in Biology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Genomics, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Immunology, Neuroscience, Microbiology, or a closely related life science field.
  2. Hands-on research experience in an academic, institutional, or industry research laboratory.
  3. Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).

Strongly Preferred

  1. Wet lab experience: you have personally performed experiments (e.g., PCR/qPCR, cell culture, sequencing library prep, Western blot, protein purification, LC-MS sample prep, CRISPR workflows).
  2. Academic research experience: postdoctoral position, staff scientist, research faculty, or equivalent.
  3. Peer-reviewed publications, ideally as first or corresponding author.
  4. PhD from a top research university (US, UK, or other leading institutions).

title: Sr Manufacturing Engineer – Sourced Hardware
description:
Job Description Summary

The Senior Manufacturing Engineer will manage and coordinate delivery projects within the Supplier Performance & Execution Sourcing Section. You will organize and coordinate multi-functional teams to execute on product delivery improvements, support the Sourcing team and suppliers to resolve technical issues, while providing expertise to the team on manufacturing processes.

Job Description

Company Overview
Working at GE Aerospace means you are bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team working to advance aerospace for future generations. If you have ideas, we will listen. Join us and see your ideas take flight!

Site Overview
Established in 2000, the John F. Welch Technology Center (JFWTC) in Bengaluru is our multidisciplinary research and engineering center. Engineers and scientists at JFWTC have contributed to hundreds of aviation patents, pioneering breakthroughs in engine technologies, advanced materials, and additive manufacturing

Role Overview

  • Manufacturing Engineering focal for assigned supplier base. Expected to own the technical performance of multiple suppliers so supplier travel will be frequent (25-50%).
  • Proactively identifies delivery barriers and resolves with fulfilment, commercial and quality team members. Is recognized as a critical team member by supplier or commodity
  • Acts as a Project Manager for large complex suppliers along with others
  • Has manufacturing expertise across multiple related part families and processes, along with deep domain expertise.
  • Guides and influences suppliers’ performance based on manufacturing expertise.
  • Actively drives cost reduction efforts within assigned supply base and is proactively engaged in addressing cost issues.
  • Active in supplier selection based on value. Partners with commercial owners to ensure supplier selection provides desired value
  • Supports source changes as needed and develops lower performing suppliers

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED with a minimum of 4 years of experience in Manufacturing)
  • At least 10 - 15 years of experience in Manufacturing, Engineering or Production Management

Desired Characteristics:

  • Expertise in programming or mechanically supporting traditional (milling, turning, broach, weld) and/or non-traditional (EDM, 3D printing) machining methods.
  • Souring, Shop Operations, or Production Control expertise
  • Manufacturing Experience in Aerospace or Automotive a plus
  • Humble: respectful, inclusive, good listener, learns from past
  • Transparent: Candid in feedback, shares to solve problems, helps grow others
  • Focused: Safety first, prioritizes work, measures success by the customer, continuously improves
  • Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision-maker, collaborative​
  • Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker

At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on really cool things with really smart and collaborative people. Together, we will mobilize a new era of growth in aerospace and defense. Where others stop, we accelerate.

This Job Description is intended to provide a high-level guide to the role. However, it is not intended to amend or otherwise restrict/expand the duties required from each individual employee as set out in their respective employment contract and/or as otherwise agreed between an employee and their manager.

Additional Information

- This is a remote position
